Return to Service is now a complete decommission workflow — it erases the Mac, removes it from Jamf, and cleans it out of Microsoft Entra, all from one action.
**One action, full cleanup** - Erases the Mac, then removes its Jamf computer record - Deletes the Mac's device object(s) from Microsoft Entra so it can re-register cleanly with Platform SSO / Company Portal
**Safer by design** - Type **ERASE** to confirm before anything happens - The Jamf record is removed only *after* the device acknowledges the erase — so the wipe always lands and you never orphan an unmanaged Mac - A live progress window shows each step as it runs
**Built for recovery** - Intel/T2 Macs show a 6-digit recovery PIN in the result — record it to unlock the Mac after the wipe. Apple Silicon doesn't need one, so it's hidden - Every step is written to **Logs** for a full audit trail
Find it on any computer under **Actions → Return to Service**. Entra cleanup runs automatically when configured.

The Report Builder has been rebuilt from the ground up — faster to use, with more ways to slice your fleet, and a much better results experience.
**Build reports faster** - Collapsible sections, with your active filters pinned to the top - A new *Individual Device* scope — pull one device by serial or asset tag
**More ways to filter** - Computer Group and Device Group filters, with a searchable list of every smart and static group - Jamf Protect coverage (Has / Missing / Stale record) for your Macs - All of Cleanup's stale-device filters, right in the builder
**A better results view** - Results open in a focused window you can search across name, serial, model, OS, and more — and sort by any column - Click any device to jump straight to its full detail
**Export that just works** - One click to CSV, Excel, PDF, or Markdown — with your applied filters listed right in the file - Optionally include Device Enrollment (ADE) details, including serials that are in Apple Business Manager but not yet in Jamf
**New: Environment Health Scorecard** - A dedicated report of fleet compliance plus a managed-device breakdown by OS, exportable in every format
Open **Reports** to take it for a spin. Cleanup settings now live in **Settings → Cleanup**.
